strings.name: Anthony Albanese
strings.summary: Raised in Sydney public housing, Albanese studied economics and worked in Labor politics before entering parliament in 1996. A former infrastructure minister and deputy prime minister, he led Labor from 2019, became prime minister in 2022 and won re-election in 2025. His climate and labor agenda also faced the failed 2023 Indigenous Voice referendum.
